description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests related to managing parental control devices, including enabling/disabling managed devices, allowing/blocking all devices, adding, editing, and deleting device entries with conflict checking.

methods.name: session_start
methods.description: Starts a new session or resumes an existing one.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Checks if a value is within a specified array.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets a configuration or parameter string value.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration or parameter string value.

methods.name: printableCharacters
methods.description: Validates if a string contains only printable characters.

methods.name: is_allowed_string
methods.description: Checks if a string is allowed based on custom criteria.

methods.name: validTime
methods.description: Validates start and end time inputs.

methods.name: getInstanceIDs
methods.description: Retrieves instance IDs for device objects.

methods.name: addTblObj
methods.description: Adds a new table object for device management.

methods.name: delTblObj
methods.description: Deletes a table object for device management.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values for device entries.

methods.name: time_date_conflict
methods.description: Checks for conflicts between time and date ranges.

methods.name: days_time_conversion_set
methods.description: Converts local time to UTC or vice versa.

methods.name: days_time_conversion_get
methods.description: Converts stored time data back to local time.
